description: This Rust source file implements the KeyMint HAL service for Android, establishing communication with a trusted application (TA) on the Cuttlefish host. It sets up device communication, registers multiple services, and sends boot and environment info to the TA.

classes.description: A wrapper around std::fs::File implementing the SerializedChannel trait for communication.
